items.title: What Does Uber Technologies (UBER) Gain From Its 47 State Delivery Expansion?
items.summary: Uber Technologies (NYSE:UBER) and Costco Wholesale expanded their delivery partnership to cover 47 U.S. states and nearly 600 warehouses. Costco delivery via Uber Eats now includes new membership perks and gift card benefits specifically targeted at Costco members. Uber describes this as its broadest single retailer expansion for Uber Eats in the U.S., widening its grocery delivery reach against key competitors. This wider Costco delivery rollout through Uber Eats is a fresh piece of context...
